note: Daily / necessary / supersubstantial bread: a hapax; lexical.
Poor in spirit: dative of reference vs. sphere; mostly interpretive.
Has come / has come upon: lexical.
After the Sabbath / late on the Sabbath: lexical.
Wisdom justified by her works or children: lexical plus textual.
It is enough / he is away / paid in full: lexical.
Having thought on it / began / threw himself: lexical.
